description: Deletes a Forge app property. This API can only be accessed using **[asApp()](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/apis-reference/fetch-api-product.requestconfluence/#method-signature)** requests from Forge.

401.description: The request did not originate from the Forge app.

403.description:
Returned when the request is forbidden due to one of the following:
- The request attempts impersonation. Only requests made using `asApp()` are allowed.
- The Forge app is not installed.
